slices.focus: Tasha secures budget for volunteer training materials and part-time admin support; receives modest raise
slices.summary: Tasha achieves a structural win: budget approval for volunteer training materials and part-time administrative help for roster maintenance, plus a modest salary increase tied to her expanded responsibilities. The agent helps her plan a three-bucket task handoff (repetitive/rules-based tasks go first, exceptions documented, higher-stakes pattern-reading kept), use the old binder as a training map, define ninety-day stability goals (fewer after-hours corrections, cleaner rosters, materials flowing without last-minute assembly), and split the raise between savings cushion and time-buying convenience. Tasha recognizes the real milestone: 'The system stops depending on my private reserve of labor.' She commits to capping version-one documents and not filling the breathing room with new projects.
